==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
An old ice cream man tries to grab me. His goal is to stick my feet in a vat of ice cream. I protest that the man is weird and gross, but other people think it is harmless.

I am so surprised by this that I suddenly enter a pitch black void as everything around me disappears. I realize that I am dreaming. Using my willpower I summon a browser window in mid air.

I use the browser window to access a menu of worlds. I have so many options of places to go and things to do. My memory after this point becomes hazy and the next thing I know I am awake.
